name: Agent CA Deactivation Status Advice V 01
definition: Scope|This message is sent by a CSD to an issuer (or its agent) to report the status, or a change in status, of a corporate action deactivation instruction or the status of a deactivation cancellation request.|Usage|This message is used to provide a status on the deactivation instruction, especially to confirm the deactivation of a Corporate Action event or option.

AgentCADeactivationCancellationRequestId.name: Agent CA Deactivation Cancellation Request Identification

DeactivationInstructionStatusOrDeactivat.definition: Either DeactivationInstructionStatus or DeactivationCancellationRequestStatus must be present.
Either DeactivationInstructionStatus or DeactivationCancellationRequestStatus must be present.

DeactivationInstructionStatusRule.definition: If AgentCADeactivationInstructionIdentification is present, then at least one occurrence of DeactivationInstructionStatus must be present.

DeactivationCancellationRequestStatusRul.definition: If AgentCADeactivationCancellationRequestIdentification is present, then DeactivationCancellationRequestStatus must be present.
